saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 14ης Φεβρουαρίου — «Όσιος Αβραάμης»

attestations.note: The Greek form is «Αβραάμης», which the page's distich sets against the patriarch's «Αβραάμ». It dates him «κατά τους χρόνους του αυτοκράτορα Θεοδοσίου του Μεγάλου (395 - 408 μ.Χ.)» — the years the page prints for Theodosius the Great are in fact those of Arcadius, and the disagreement is the page's own. It adds that Theodoret of Cyrrhus wrote his life.
Not checked: the Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the corresponding Julian day (19 September 2026).

floruit.display: under the emperor the page calls Theodosius the Great
floruit.note: saint.gr: «Ο Όσιος Αβραάμης έζησε κατά τους χρόνους του αυτοκράτορα Θεοδοσίου του Μεγάλου (395 - 408 μ.Χ.)». The interval is the reign the page itself prints. Those years are Arcadius's and not Theodosius the Great's, who died in 395; the mismatch is recorded here and not corrected, because the source's reading is the fact.
